headline: SIMULATION: Major cyber attack on Australia.
summary: THIS IS A SIMULATION - NOTHING HAS HAPPENED. In this scenario, a major cyber attack is under way against Australia and the Australian Cyber Security Centre has issued a national alert. Banking, payments and some phone services may be disrupted. Level 4 means act on the family plan now.
actions: Get some cash out while ATMs are working
Charge phones, power banks and radios
Ignore texts, emails and calls asking you to log in or pay

scenarios.sa_impact: Cards and EFTPOS unreliable; cash needed for food and fuel.
